tool_args.rationale: The target horizon H=21.7 lies in the range where the recalled dual-horizon mechanism may reverse sign, while current observations only cover H=0.16–0.48. Acquire the slow-horizon probe to discriminate the slow adaptation contribution before fitting.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the dual-horizon endogenous-adaptation model to the five initial rows
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: All observations are short-horizon, positive-gain measurements with fixed u_past and zero x_now, mem_conv, and s_grad; they cannot identify the slow timescale or establish reversal near the target horizon.
A finer short-horizon trajectory would not resolve the key long-horizon ambiguity, and the recalled mechanism note explicitly recommends the slow-horizon discriminating probe first.
It is unrelated to the identified ambiguity and should not be purchased.
